chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Berlin, 2006: the World Cup final. Here’s how Claude Makélélé played. Italy look for Totti, but Makélélé stays in front of him. The pass goes in… Makélélé steps across, and it’s his!

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He keeps shuffling, always between the ball and his goal. When the pass comes, he’s already there.

chapters.label: Simple
chapters.text: No tricks. He looks up and passes it simply to Patrick Vieira. France attack!

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That’s the Makélélé role. It quietly protects the whole team! Stay between the ball and your goal. When you win it, pass it simply.
